scope: Data-only accounting for maintained Bend modules enumerated by compiler.json. Counts are structural size proxies, not a semantic complexity score or proof of runtime speedup. Runtime, host code, tests, documentation and unlisted legacy sources are excluded from source totals; selected API bytes are separate. Existing emission identity receipts are cross-checked against frozen manifests and actual phase44 module bytes; no compiler or program executes.

method.nonblankNonCommentLines: Nonempty after strip and not starting # after lstrip; inline-comment lines count as code.
method.moduleSizeWeighting: Point geometric mean over45 ratios; equal-source is geometric mean of within-source point geometric means over23 source hashes.
